question.text: A radioactive substance decays exponentially such that its mass reduces by $\dfrac 1 4$ every hour. If the mass of the substance was initially $2\,\textrm{kg},$ what is the mass of the substance after $9$ hours?
question.explanation:
If the mass reduces by $\dfrac 1 4,$ then $\dfrac 3 4$ of its mass remains every hour.

Therefore:

  • After $1$ hour, the mass is $2\cdot \left(\dfrac 3 4\right).$

  • After $\color{blue}2$ hours, the mass is $2\cdot \left(\dfrac 3 4\right)^{\color{blue}2}.$

  • After $\color{blue}3$ hours, the mass is $2\cdot \left(\dfrac 3 4\right)^{\color{blue}3}.$

  • $\ldots$

Repeating this pattern, we see that the mass after $\color{blue}9$ hours is $2\cdot \left(\dfrac 3 4\right)^{\color{blue}9}\,\textrm{kg}.$

example.title: Creating an Exponential Decay Expression From a Decay Factor

question.text: A soccer club started with $120$ members. The number of members in the club then decreased by $\dfrac 1 5$ every year. Which expression gives approximately the number of members after $3$ years?
question.explanation:
If the number of members reduced by $\dfrac 1 5$ every year, it means that $\dfrac 4 5$ of members remained every year.

Therefore:

  • After $1$ year, there were $120\cdot \left(\dfrac 4 5\right)$ members.

  • After $\color{blue}2$ years, there were approximately $120\cdot \left(\dfrac 4 5\right)^{\color{blue}2}$ members.

  • After $\color{blue}3$ years, there were approximately $120\cdot \left(\dfrac 4 5\right)^{\color{blue}3}$ members.

example.title: Creating an Exponential Decay Expression From a Decay Factor

question.text: Nathan invested $\$5\,600$ into a company which then went on to lose $7\%$ of its value every year. Which expression gives the value of Nathan's investment after $3$ years?
question.explanation:
The number $7\%$ (expressed as a decimal) is equal to $0.07.$ Therefore, a decrease of $7\%$ corresponds to multiplication by a factor of:

\[ 1 - 0.07 = 0.93 \]

Therefore:

  • After $1$ year, the value of the investment was $5\,600\cdot (0.93)$ dollars.

  • After $\color{blue}2$ years, the value of the investment was $5\,600\cdot (0.93)^{\color{blue}2}$ dollars.

  • After $\color{blue} 3$ years, the value of the investment was $5\,600\cdot (0.93)^{\color{blue}3}$ dollars.
